pathways.compact_statement: Climate pressures can interact with relocation land constraints and exclusion to create tensions; kinship networks and inclusive local decisions can support adaptation.
alternative_explanations: Education, employment and family connections also drive mobility.
Land exclusion, external project design and existing governance disputes can cause tension independently of climate.
pathways.uncertainty: Conditional synthesis of selected-site research and contextual peacebuilding analysis, not a nationwide causal estimate. Source-specific examples do not establish that each mechanism occurs in every named site.
recommendations: No structural linkage issue identified; review each cited passage for its specific causal link, alternatives and uncertainty before treating the pathway as verified.

pathways.compact_statement: One Honiara 2014 case links flood displacement, perceived inadequate rehabilitation and a protest-turned-riot; aggregate study findings do not establish a general disaster-conflict effect.
alternative_explanations: Disaster-recovery governance and existing political grievances may shape protest independently of the flood. The aggregate study reports a null association.
pathways.uncertainty: Media-coded historical example, not an event-attribution study or quantified mechanism. Do not generalize across settlements, provinces or future disasters.
recommendations: Retain only evidence whose documented geography supports the pathway location; otherwise narrow the pathway or keep the evidence standalone.
